test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the part that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

That will truly / been a milestone to / celebrate.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'been a milestone to'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error is:** "been a milestone to".**
 
• This **error is related to** tense consistency. 
 
• Tenses should not be mixed within a sentence unless there is a shift in the time frame within the context of the sentence.
 
• In this case, the **correct tense should be** future, so** 'been' **should be replaced with** 'be'.**
 
• **'Been' **is a past participle and doesn't fit here as the rest of the sentence is in future tense indicated by **'will'.**

So the **correct sentence **should be:* "That will truly be a milestone to celebrate."*
